edges.note: Granules fed from a hopper are melted by the rotating screw in the heated barrel: shown in the PD schematic Injection moulding process (1).png (viewed). The screw photo was not viewed; the Styron advertisement shows the polystyrene as granules, not the melting. No photograph of the melt itself was found (melt is enclosed in the barrel); the film's melt is a declared handmade simulation.

Diagram (viewed) shows melt charge -> sprue -> runner -> gates -> cavities -> parts; Mold cavity.jpg (viewed) labels each part as the cavity still joined to the runner. This is the edge 'cavity = part'.
Spritzguss teile.jpg (viewed) shows both states of one tool side by side: rings on the runner, and runner + loose rings after degating.

hypotheses_unverified.note: Runner scrap is ground and returned to the hopper as regrind. Real practice, but no open evidence foraged in this run; not an edge of the tour and must not be shown as one.

evidence.title: Injection moulding process (1).png
evidence.author: derivative of Injection_moulding_process.png by Laurens (per Commons Artist field)
